metadata.title: Sloppy Joe's Bar - Cocktails Manual (1936)
metadata.author: Jose Abeal (Sloppy Joe)
metadata.notes: Folleto bilingue del famoso bar Sloppy Joe's de La Habana, fundado por Jose Abeal. Incluye una breve biografia del fundador y recetas organizadas por base alcoholica (ron, ginebra, vermouth, cognac, whisky, ajenjo, etc.). Texto principal en ingles con nombres de cocteles en ingles y espanol.

sections.title: Sloppy Joe's - Short Biography
sections.content_original: Mr. Jose Abeal (Sloppy Joe) came from Spain to Cuba in the year 1904 and went to work as bartender on Galiano and Zanja Sts. Havana, where he worked for three years, and then he gave up his job and sailed for New-Orleans, La. (U.S.A.). In this City he went on working as bartender for six years. From New-Orleans he went to Miami, Fla., and also worked in different Bars during another six years. In the year 1918 he returned to Havana and got a job as bartender at a Cafe named 'Greasy Spoon' and six months after, he decided to go in business for himself and bought what was then an insignificant grocery store at the same corner now occupied by the famous Sloppy Joe's Bar. While operating this small grocery store, he was visited by several of his old friends from the States. It so happened, that while some of them were visiting him and seeing the poor appearance and filthy looking condition of the place, one of them said: 'Why, Joe, this place is certainly sloppy, look at the filthy water running from under the counter'. From here on, the name Sloppy Joe stuck to Jose Abeal as part of his own life and was destined to make him and his business famous and internationally known.
sections.content_es: El Sr. Jose Abeal (Sloppy Joe) vino de Espana a Cuba en el ano 1904 y empezo a trabajar como cantinero en las calles Galiano y Zanja, La Habana, donde trabajo durante tres anos. Despues dejo su empleo y partio hacia Nueva Orleans, Luisiana (EE.UU.). En esa ciudad continuo trabajando como cantinero durante seis anos. De Nueva Orleans paso a Miami, Florida, y tambien trabajo en distintos bares durante otros seis anos. En el ano 1918 regreso a La Habana y consiguio empleo como cantinero en un cafe llamado 'Greasy Spoon' (Cuchara Grasienta) y seis meses despues decidio establecerse por su cuenta y compro lo que entonces era una insignificante pulperia en la misma esquina que hoy ocupa el famoso Sloppy Joe's Bar. Mientras operaba esta pequena pulperia, fue visitado por varios de sus viejos amigos de los Estados Unidos. Sucedio que, mientras algunos de ellos lo visitaban y veian el aspecto pobre y la condicion sucia del lugar, uno de ellos dijo: 'Vaya, Joe, este lugar esta ciertamente sucio (sloppy), mira el agua sucia que corre por debajo del mostrador'. A partir de entonces, el nombre Sloppy Joe quedo unido a Jose Abeal como parte de su propia vida y estaba destinado a hacerle a el y a su negocio famosos y reconocidos internacionalmente.

sections.title: Why is Sloppy Joe's Bar Famous and Internationally Known?
sections.title_es: Por que es famoso e internacionalmente conocido el Sloppy Joe's Bar?
sections.content_original: In the first place, because Joe made it a rule in his business always to give the best for the money. He never cared to handle any product that was not genuine, and always tried to serve his customers with whatever they wanted at the most reasonable prices. In order to fulfill this purpose, he labored to have his Bar stocked with all the best liquors wherever produced, regardless of the cost, as long as he could meet the demands of his clients and please them.
sections.content_es: En primer lugar, porque Joe establecio como norma de su negocio dar siempre lo mejor por el dinero. Nunca quiso manejar producto alguno que no fuera genuino, y siempre intento servir a sus clientes con lo que desearan a los precios mas razonables. Con el fin de cumplir este proposito, se esforzo por tener su bar surtido con los mejores licores, sin importar donde se produjeran ni el costo, siempre que pudiera satisfacer las demandas de su clientela y complacerlos.

sections.title: Take Your Friends a Real Gift - Sloppy Joe's Cigars & Ron
sections.title_es: Lleva a tus amigos un verdadero regalo - Tabacos y Ron Sloppy Joe's
sections.content_original: In this delightful island grows the mild and fragrant leaf for the filler of the SLOPPY JOE'S CIGARS. The same fine tobacco that makes this island famous are blended to your taste in SLOPPY JOE'S CIGARS. Before you go home don't forget to take a bottle of SLOPPY JOE'S RON. This Ron is guaranteed to be over 12 years old. GOLD / WHITE.
sections.content_es: En esta deliciosa isla crece la hoja suave y fragante para el relleno de los TABACOS SLOPPY JOE'S. El mismo fino tabaco que hace famosa esta isla se mezcla a tu gusto en los TABACOS SLOPPY JOE'S. Antes de regresar a casa no olvides llevar una botella de RON SLOPPY JOE'S. Este Ron esta garantizado de mas de 12 anos. ORO / BLANCO.
